notes.title: Zen: A Gay Sequel is out on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello YAGS players! We're thankful for your reviews and positive reception, and are glad that you're enjoying Yearning: A Gay Story. If you aren't following the Twitter accounts of [url=https://twitter.com/bobcgames]bobcgames[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/ProjectEnso_]Project Ensō[/url], you may have missed the news about the release of ZAGS on Steam!

Zen: A Gay Sequel is the sequel to YAGS, this time from Carlos' perspective following the end of Winter Break. With added gameplay in the form of stat building, a weekly planner, 12 minigames, and more, you'll get to know characters old and new from the same campus! There's also 24 CGs you can collect in the game to illustrate intimate moments with love interests,

ZAGS is currently 20% off until September 9, so there's still time to buy it on the launch discount. Don't wait too long!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724600/Zen_A_Gay_Sequel/
